claims.text: YouTrack offers a free cloud plan for teams of up to 10 users.
YouTrack paid cloud plans start at $3.67 per user per month. (price check unavailable) (source text unavailable, not judged)
YouTrack plan costs can reach $600 depending on the selected plan. (price check unavailable) (source text unavailable, not judged)
YouTrack costs approximately $50 per month for a team of 10 users and about $500 per month for a team of 100 users.
Starting October 2025, new YouTrack monthly subscriptions begin at $5.40 per user per month and annual subscriptions begin at $4.50 per user per month.
YouTrack offers volume discounts that increase as more users are added.
YouTrack includes its full feature set, support, and AI assistance at no additional charge in paid subscriptions.
YouTrack provides discounts for startups, educational institutions, non-profit organizations, and open-source projects.
YouTrack helpdesk functionality is free for up to 3 support agents.
For teams with 4 or more support agents, YouTrack charges $6 per agent per month on monthly billing and $5.50 per agent per month on annual billing.
Each YouTrack support agent must also hold a user license.
YouTrack Server remains free for teams of up to 10 users.
YouTrack Server annual subscriptions are listed at $900 for 15 users, $1,500 for 25 users, and $3,000 for 50 users.
YouTrack retains backups of removed instances for up to 6 months.
Initial setup and implementation for small and medium businesses using YouTrack may cost only a few hundred dollars.
YouTrack enterprise implementation, customization, training, and migration can range from $5,000 to $50,000.
For a team of 100 users, YouTrack is approximately $250 less expensive per month than Jira’s standard plan.
Selecting YouTrack’s Team plan instead of the Enterprise tier can save over $120 per user per year.
YouTrack supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on for both service-provider and identity-provider initiated login.

YouTrack’s enterprise tier includes SAML-based single sign-on, two-factor authentication enforcement, audit logs, project templates, advanced workflow designers, priority support, and custom project roles.
YouTrack includes built-in time tracking for recording estimated and actual time spent on issues.
YouTrack provides interactive Gantt charts for scheduling and prioritizing tasks.
YouTrack includes a Knowledge Base for organizing internal documentation and public user guides.
YouTrack supports customizable Agile boards for Kanban, Scrum, and mixed methodologies.
YouTrack comes with configurable reports and dashboards for tracking performance indicators.
YouTrack includes automation for backlog management and a feature to move unfinished items to the next sprint.
YouTrack is known for powerful search and query functions for managing issues and tasks.
YouTrack’s free InCloud plan includes up to 30 GB of total storage and private projects.
YouTrack free plans include all functionality except the custom logo option.
Like Jira, YouTrack is primarily geared toward software project management.
Taiga is an open-source alternative to YouTrack that supports Scrum and Kanban methodologies.
GitLab Issues is available as part of GitLab’s free tier.
Plane offers a self-hosted open-source option with unlimited users at no cost.
Basecamp is a lightweight alternative designed for small teams with to-dos, schedules, chat, and file storage.
Jira’s Standard plan starts at approximately $7.91 per user per month and its Premium plan at approximately $14.54 per user per month for teams of up to 300 users.
Linear’s Basic plan costs $10 per user per month when billed yearly and $12 per user per month when billed monthly.
Linear’s Business plan costs $16 per user per month when billed yearly and $18 per user per month when billed monthly.
GitLab Premium is priced at $29 per user per month.
GitLab SaaS plans range from $0 to $1,188 per user per year in cost. (source text unavailable, not judged)
Engineering teams frustrated by speed may switch to Linear from YouTrack.
Teams unfamiliar with custom workflows may find YouTrack requires complex setup and has a steep learning curve if they do not already use JetBrains tools.
YouTrack is recognized as a top cloud project management option for extensive customization and collaborative tools.
One reviewer found that YouTrack’s automation features reduced manual backlog upkeep more than any other tool they tested.
Alternatives and competitors to YouTrack include Jira, Linear, GitLab, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Smartsheet, Wrike, Basecamp, Taiga, Zoho Sprints, Zenkit, and Plane. (judge: not_stated)
Zenkit offers Kanban, list view, Gantt charts, wikis, and group chats as an alternative to YouTrack. (judge: not_stated)
